newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian unemployment rises to 12 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian unemployment rises to 12 pct in November.

text.p: The number of people unemployed in Bulgaria rose to 460,061 or 12 percent of the workforce in November from 425,419 in October, the National Labour Exchange (NLE) said.

"The number of jobless registered with us rose 8.1 percent month-on-month in November due to the inflow of people from closed state enterprises and a fall in the number of seasonal job offers," NLE chairman Milcho Dimitrov told Reuters.
He said the seasonal decline in the number of job offers affected mostly farming and construction.
"I expect unemployment to rise further in December," Dimitrov said. He did not elaborate.

Bulgaria, hit by a severe economic crisis and preparing for the introduction of a tough monetary regime, has earmarked 64 loss-making state firms for closure under a funding agreement with the International Monetary Fund sealed in July.
